items.title: Wilbur DeParis Interview, 1959-06-26
items.q: later on I came back and got my brother Sidney and brought him to Philadelphia that I had this big band

ctx.x: and then after him who did you go with? do you remember?

yes I went with myself organized my own band and later on I came back and got my brother Sidney and brought him to Philadelphia that I had this big band and I've had bands of my own off and on all my life ever since well as you can see if I had a band when I was 18 with Billy Mack Merrymakers I've had them practically all my life
well what were some of the best jobs you've ever played in music?
